overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission met remotely to review bicycle lane designs for Salem Street and Winthrop Street, discuss updates to the city's bicycle master plan, and coordinate upcoming community safety events.

items.title: Opening and Roll Call
items.summary: The meeting was called to order remotely and roll call was conducted alongside guest introductions.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: The chair reported submitting a letter of support for a Mystic River Watershed Association grant application and outlined plans to improve city web resources for non-car travel.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to approve the previous meeting minutes with minor date corrections.

items.title: Salem Street Bike Lanes
items.summary: Commission members and city staff reviewed traffic plans for Salem Street bike lanes, focusing on bus stop positioning, lane merges, buffer zones, and warning signs.

items.title: Master Plan Updates and Priority Routes
items.summary: Staff and members discussed baseline data collection for the bike master plan, potential design standards based on street width, and identifying neighborway bypass routes.

items.title: Winthrop Street Bike Infrastructure
items.summary: City officials outlined plans to add bike lanes along Winthrop Street during upcoming utility repaving, addressing parking impacts, rotary navigation, and winter maintenance concerns.

items.title: Bike Lights Program and Community Events
items.summary: The commission reviewed distribution progress for the youth bike light program and finalized logistics for the June 3 helmet rodeo at Tufts Park and the July 28 Farmers Market Bike Fest.

items.title: MassDOT Capital Plan and Working Groups
items.summary: The chair noted the public comment window for the MassDOT capital investment plan and encouraged members to form working groups to map local routes.
